newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy rates Budimex as short term hold.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy rates Budimex as short term hold.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish Bank Handlowy SA rated the construction firm Budimex SA as a short term hold and long term buy, stressing the stock's attractive price but also its low 1996 earnings, Handlowy said.

It said in its report dated October 25, but released on Monday, that Budimex, which suffered severely from the harsh winter in the beginning of the year and was likely to show low 1996 net, had perspectives to grow.

"We recommend long term (three-four years) investors to buy Budimex shares as we believe the current price of the stock is attractive and its growth potential is likely to rise along with construction climate improvement," it added.
Budimex closed at 20.5 zlotys on Friday.
Handlowy saw Budimex net profit falling to 22 million zlotys this year, down from 22.7 million in 1995, but rising to 25 million zlotys next year.
It expected the company's sales to grow to 290 million zlotys in 1996 and 330 million next year, up from last year's 273.5 million.

Handlowy said Budimex, which has built one of the biggest construction holdings in Poland, could suffer from a worsening construction climate in Germany, where it was exporting a significant part of services.
